role: District Representative · Malabon City, Lone District
summary: Malabon representative with 221 principal-authored bills. Authored universal health care strengthening, free annual medical check-ups, a barangay health worker Magna Carta, a higher nurses' salary grade, HMO regulation, limits on unhealthy food marketing to children, an anti-dynasty ban and a national budget blockchain system. Also called for a constitutional convention and a children's online safety framework.
caveat: Children's digital safety bill is a single issue and civil liberties is unscored. Constitutional convention scored neutral.
